info.title: BCC Showcase Wall API
info.description:
RESTful API & WebSocket contract for **BCC Showcase Wall** — **Apidog Ready with Auto-Fill JWT Tokens, Chained IDs & Prefilled Examples**.

### ⚡ Apidog Zero-Guessing Quickstart (Auto-Fill Enabled)
1. **Import this `api-docs.json` into Apidog** (`Settings` → `Import Data` → `OpenAPI/Swagger`).
2. **One-Click Login (Auto-Saves `{{access_token}}`)**:
   - Open **`POST /api/v1/auth/login`** → Select an example (e.g., **"1. Seeded Admin"** or **"3. Contributor"**) → Click **Send**.
   - Immediately returns `200 OK` and automatically saves `data.access_token` into your Apidog `{{access_token}}` environment/global variable and sets the `refresh_token` HttpOnly cookie.
   - Every protected endpoint is pre-configured with both `BearerAuth` and a pre-filled `Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}` header so your JWT token is sent automatically!
3. **Create a Work (Auto-Saves `{{work_id}}`)**:
   - Open **`POST /api/v1/works`** → All form fields (`title`, `summary`, `description`, `benefits`, `category`, `tech_stack`, `team_members`, `demo_url`, `repo_url`) are pre-filled! Just pick any `.jpg`/`.png`/`.webp` file for `cover` and click **Send**.
   - Automatically saves `data.id` into `{{work_id}}`, so all `/works/{id}`, `/me/works/{id}`, `/media/works/{id}/*`, and `/admin/works/{id}/*` endpoints are automatically pre-filled!
4. **Add a Screenshot (Auto-Saves `{{screenshot_id}}`)**:
   - Open **`POST /api/v1/works/{id}/screenshots`** → Upload an `image` file and click **Send**.
   - Automatically saves `data.id` into `{{screenshot_id}}` for `GET /api/v1/media/works/{id}/screenshots/{imageId}` and `DELETE /api/v1/works/{id}/screenshots/{imageId}`.

### 🔌 WebSocket Contract (`GET /ws/wall` & `GET /api/v1/ws/wall`)
- **URL**: `wss://group5-be.bccdev.id/ws/wall` (or `ws://localhost:8080/ws/wall`)
- **Access**: Public, read-only.
- **Envelope**: `{ "type": string, "seq": number, "payload": object }`
- **Events**: `work.published`, `work.unpublished`, `work.deleted`

post.summary: Sign In / Sign Up with Firebase OAuth (Google & Auto-Fill Token)
post.description:
Exchanges a Firebase ID Token (`id_token`) obtained on the frontend for a backend session (`access_token` + `HttpOnly` `refresh_token` cookie) without requiring an email OTP code. Automatically saves `{{access_token}}`.

**Account Resolution Rules:**
- **Returning OAuth User**: Matched by `firebase_uid`.
- **Existing Local User (Unlinked)**: Automatically links `firebase_uid` to the existing account and sets `auth_provider = "both"`.
- **New Email**: Creates user with `password_hash = NULL`, `auth_provider = "google"`, and role `Contributor`. Admins are created only on the server with the `/app/seed` command.
- **Conflict**: If the email is already linked to a different `firebase_uid`, returns `409 oauth_account_conflict`.

error.message: Token Google tidak valid atau sudah kedaluwarsa
Email Anda belum diverifikasi oleh penyedia login

error.message: Email ini sudah tertaut ke akun Google lain

post.summary: Rotate Refresh Token & Issue New Access Token (Auto-Fills Token)
post.description: Reads the `refresh_token` HttpOnly cookie, rotates the session in PostgreSQL, sets a new `refresh_token` cookie, and returns a new 15-minute `access_token` (automatically updating `{{access_token}}`). Presenting a previously rotated token revokes the entire session family (`invalid_session`).

401.description: Missing, expired, revoked, or reused refresh token (`invalid_session`); clears cookie

error.message: Sesi tidak valid, silakan masuk kembali

get.summary: Stream Work Cover Image (Public or Signed)
get.description: Streams the cover image of a work from disk. Public for a `Published` work (supports `ETag` / `If-None-Match` `304 Not Modified`, returns `404` immediately once hidden or deleted). For `Draft` or `Unpublished` works, requires valid `exp` and `sig` query parameters issued to the owner or an Admin.

parameters.name: exp
parameters.description: HMAC signature expiry timestamp (Unix seconds); required only for Draft/Unpublished works.

parameters.name: sig
parameters.description: HMAC-SHA256 signature; required only for Draft/Unpublished works.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Optional ETag for conditional requests on Published works.

304.description: Not Modified (ETag matched for Published work)

404.description: Work not found, not Published, or missing/expired signature (`media_not_found`)

get.summary: Stream Work Screenshot Image (Public or Signed)
get.description: Public for a `Published` work (stable URL, `404` once hidden or deleted). For `Draft` or `Unpublished` works, the URL must carry the `exp` and `sig` query values issued to the owner or an Admin; otherwise `404`.

parameters.name: exp
parameters.description: Signature expiry (Unix seconds), non-published works only

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Optional ETag for conditional requests on Published works.

304.description: Not Modified (ETag matched for Published work)

404.description: Not found, not public, or bad/expired signature (`media_not_found`)

get.summary: WebSocket Live Showcase Wall Stream (Root Path)
get.description: Upgrades the HTTP connection to a public, read-only RFC 6455 WebSocket stream (`wss://<host>/ws/wall`). Broadcasts JSON envelopes `{ "type", "seq", "payload" }` whenever a work is published (`work.published`), unpublished (`work.unpublished`), or deleted (`work.deleted`). Rate-limited to 20 handshakes/min per IP, max 10 concurrent connections per IP, and 500 total connections.

400.description: Missing or invalid WebSocket upgrade headers (`websocket_upgrade_required` / `websocket_key_missing`)

get.summary: WebSocket Live Showcase Wall Stream (/api/v1 Alias)
get.description: Alias of `GET /ws/wall` mounted under `/api/v1/ws/wall` so reverse proxies forwarding `/api/v1/*` can upgrade WebSocket connections seamlessly.

400.description: Missing or invalid WebSocket upgrade headers (`websocket_upgrade_required` / `websocket_key_missing`)
